config:
# DeFi Pulse: a small mainnet nest of the events people check daily, light enough for a browser tab.
# Stablecoin issuance, Aave v3 liquidations, Lido staking flows and the ETH/USD price, from 2026-01-01.

[nest]
name = "defi-pulse"
chain = "mainnet"
chain_id = 1
rpc_urls = ["https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com"]   # a keyed endpoint goes on the command line: --rpc
schema_version = 1
block_timestamps = true

# USDC: a proxy, so the events come from the implementation's ABI.
[[contracts]]
alias = "usdc"
address = "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48"
start_block = 24136053
abi = "abis/usdc.json"
events = ["Mint", "Burn"]

[[contracts]]
alias = "usdt"
address = "0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7"
start_block = 24136053
abi = "abis/usdt.json"
events = ["Issue", "Redeem"]

# Aave v3 Pool: a proxy; LiquidationCall from the implementation's ABI.
[[contracts]]
alias = "aave"
address = "0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2"
start_block = 24136053
abi = "abis/aave_pool.json"
events = ["LiquidationCall"]

[[contracts]]
alias = "steth"
address = "0xae7ab96520DE3A18E5e111B5EaAb095312D7fE84"
start_block = 24136053
abi = "abis/steth.json"
events = ["Submitted"]

[[contracts]]
alias = "lido_wq"
address = "0x889edC2eDab5f40e902b864aD4d7AdE8E412F9B1"
start_block = 24136053
abi = "abis/lido_withdrawal_queue.json"
events = ["WithdrawalRequested", "WithdrawalsFinalized", "WithdrawalClaimed"]

# Chainlink ETH/USD. The proxy 0x5f4e…8419 emits nothing; its phase-7 aggregator, live for the whole
# range, emits AnswerUpdated. A new phase means adding the next aggregator here.
[[contracts]]
alias = "eth_usd"
address = "0x7d4E742018fb52E48b08BE73d041C18B21de6Fb5"
start_block = 24136053
abi = "abis/eth_usd.json"
events = ["AnswerUpdated"]
